policy: Exact three historical non-guard fields only; original RECIPE_MEMORY.tsv is immutable. No tests or runtime gates are waived.

entries.original_guard: unify.py refuses a move onto an existing path unless a RENAME row vacates it first, and pins the rename count per token and file

a relocation that changes a package re-checks descriptor strings ("L<path>;", "[L<path>;") and Class.forName/FindClass names next to the PKG/PKG_PATH rules; a global DESCRIPTOR rule needs a whole-tree plan with all blobs first, because javap-style evidence text may hold such descriptors
a rename treats a donor path as a fact, never as a name; TSVs consumed by tests are data and must be carried with the code they mirror
